context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren brainstorm a fresh idea.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business brainstorming; vocabulary (権力/常識/真実/発想/要因) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新しい発想が、必要だと思う。
lines.en: I think we need a fresh idea.
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 常識にとらわれず、考えてみます。
lines.en: I'll think without being bound by common sense.
lines.style: engaged young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 成功の要因は、何だと思うかね?
lines.en: What do you think is the factor for success?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 顧客の真実の声が、要因だと思います。
lines.en: I think customers' true voices are the factor.
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社内の権力争いは、無くしたいな。
lines.en: I want to eliminate internal power struggles.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 権力より、発想を大事にしたいです。
lines.en: Rather than power, I want to value ideas.
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 常識を超える発想を、歓迎するよ。
lines.en: I welcome ideas that surpass common sense.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 真実に基づいて、提案します。
lines.en: I'll propose based on the truth.
lines.style: confident young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
